Prevention: Selection tolerent varieties such as recommended are
Plough well 4 to 6 times before planting to destroy crop residue and kill pupae.
Early season planting during december to
February is ideal to avoid the pest damage.
Conserving moisture by trash (coir pith, dried trashes). mulching to a thickness of 15cm along ridges between 3-15 days after planting reduces the larval population.
Monitoring: Scout fields at 10 day intervals during
May to observe dead heart, egg masses and yellowish moths.
Keep trash traps (5 nos/ acre) to attract adults and collect egg masses.
Use pheromone traps at a rate of 4 per acre for monitoring from 1-3 months of planting change the septa/lure once in 30 days.
Consider direct control actions when 10 dead hearts are found per 100 randomly sampled plants.
Direct Control (Non-chemical): Remove infested shoots close to ground level and burn to kill larvae and pupae.
Granulosis virus (GV) at a rate of 250 ml/ acre (1x107 to 109 inclusion bodies per ml) 3 times at 15 days interval.
Tachinid fly parasite, Sturmiopsis inferens at a rate of 50 gravid females/ acre twice from 30th-50th day after planting.
On observing dead heart, release egg parasitoid, Trichogramma chilonis at a rate of 2 cc/acre from 30th day onwards 4 times at an interval of 15 days.
Neem seed kernal extract 5% at a rate of 10 kg seed/acre on 30th and 60th.
Direct Control (Chemical): Gr, Agadi-G) at a rate of 10 kg/acre.
Coragen, Rynaxpyr, Corer) at a rate of 60 ml/ acre.
Restrictions: U (unlikely to present acute hazard in normal use).
Padan, Kirtap, Caldan, Boreg) at a rate of 6 kg/ acre as whorl application at 30th and 60th days.
